subject: ddl/issyncer: support cross keyspace scenario (#62831)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Core change threads a `checkAssumedSvr` flag from DDL wait-version logic into the schema version syncer, backed by new serverinfo `Keyspace`/`AssumedKeyspace` marking and `infosync.GetServersForISSync` filtering. Cross-keyspace InfoSchema syncer/loader is added to only load reserved-ID (system) objects, skip unrelated schema diffs/MDL checks, and disable virtual table init via builder `WithCrossKS`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata consistency, concurrency, or state-machine handling for the touched DDL/infoschema/meta paths.
